zh: 跑完十公里后我筋疲力尽。
en: I was {exhausted|shattered|knackered} after the ten-kilometre run.

zh: 他非常好胜，连打乒乓球都讨厌输。
en: He's very {competitive}; he hates losing, even at table tennis.

zh: 她一周去四次健身房，所以身体非常好。
en: She goes to the gym four times a week, so she's really {fit}.

zh: 昨天徒步之后，我的腿很僵硬。
en: My legs are {stiff|tight} after yesterday's hike.

zh: 比分咬得很紧，我们只输了一分。
en: It was a {close|tight} game; we only lost by one point.

zh: 裁判对两支球队都很公平。
en: The referee was {fair} to both teams.

zh: 海上风浪太大，没法划皮划艇。
en: The sea was too {rough|choppy} for kayaking.

zh: 步道的最后一段非常陡。
en: The last part of the track is really {steep}.

zh: 下了那么多雨，球场一片泥泞。
en: The field was {muddy} after all the rain.

zh: 骑车上坡需要强壮的腿。
en: You need {strong|powerful} legs for cycling uphill.

zh: 我浑身是汗，吃晚饭前得冲个澡。
en: I'm all {sweaty}; I need a shower before dinner.

zh: 这只是个业余联赛，没人拿工资。
en: It's just an {amateur} league; nobody gets paid.

zh: 这支球队本赛季至今保持不败。
en: The team is still {unbeaten|undefeated} this season.

zh: 这些哑铃比我上周用的更重。
en: These weights are {heavier} than the ones I used last week.

zh: 自从开始游泳，我觉得精力充沛多了。
en: I feel much more {energetic} since I started swimming.

zh: 决赛非常精彩刺激，一直打到了加时赛。
en: The final was really {exciting|thrilling}; it went to extra time.

zh: 小心，球场湿的时候很滑。
en: Be careful, the court is {slippery|slick} when it's wet.

zh: 我们最好的球员受伤了，周六上不了场。
en: Our best player is {injured|hurt}, so he can't play on Saturday.

zh: 我的左手比右手弱得多。
en: My left hand is much {weaker} than my right.

zh: 我更喜欢徒步、冲浪这样的户外运动。
en: I prefer {outdoor} sports like tramping and surfing.
